Unternehmensbeschreibung
   

  

 AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas – immunology, oncology, neuroscience, and eye care – and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at www.abbvie.com. Follow @abbvie on X, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn and Tik Tok.
   

  

 Stellenbeschreibung
   

  

 People. Passion. Possibilities. Three words that make a world of difference.
   

  

 More than a job. It's a chance to make a real difference.
   

  

 Welcome to AbbVie! As part of an international company with 48,000 employees worldwide and around 3,000 employees in Germany, you will have the opportunity of addressing some of tomorrows unmet medical needs in close collaboration with your colleagues. Are you passionate about improving global health care? Do you want to contribute to improving patients' quality of life through your expertise? In a challenging work environment that offers opportunities of developing and increasing your own skills? Youve come to the right place!
   

  

**Together, we break through –** 
**as** 
**Senior Data Scientist II – Therapeutic Modality Insights \& Competitor Intelligence** 
**(all genders)**
 AbbVie’s global Information Research (IR) group has a mission to unlock information that makes cures possible. Within IR, the Enterprise Knowledge Accelerator (EKA) team is the trusted knowledge partner for clients in R\&D and the Corporate Business \& Strategy Office (CBSO). EKA drives innovation and enhances knowledge\-sharing across the value chain, for better and faster decisions that impact advancement in our pipeline. The team is a global organization, with presences at the Lake County, Illinois headquarters and Boston, Massachusetts areas (US), as well as the Ludwigshafen site (Germany). Leveraging cutting\-edge technologies and scientific expertise, we deliver industry\-leading capabilities to harness insights from published content for high\-impact decision\-making. Our team possesses the scientific and technical expertise to utilize and provide guidance on a wide range of knowledge sources, ensuring high\-quality answers for our clients.
   

  

 The Senior Data Scientist will join the Solutions for Published Insights and Client Enablement (SPICE) team, supporting AbbVie’s R\&D, CBSO and other business functions enterprise wide. SPICE provides business partnership, resource consultancy, ad\-hoc research support for business\-critical questions, knowledge and insights mining and analysis, as well as designing and building innovative self\-service solutions for insights generation from published resources and internal knowledge. This includes literature, patent, conference, news, clinical trial, and competitive intelligence data such as competitor pipelines.
   

  

 As a Senior Data Scientist on the Solutions for Published Insights \& Client Enablement (SPICE) team, you will serve as the lead data scientist focused on advancing AbbVie’s competitiveness by driving Therapeutic Modality Knowledge \& Intelligence Solutions. You will lead the creation of new methods and algorithms for extracting, harmonizing and proactive monitoring of knowledge on emerging therapeutic approaches, critically evaluate new technologies and scientific advances, and integrate them into impactful business solutions, to set AbbVie up for future success in a competitive landscape. You will play a critical role in identifying and filling strategic knowledge gaps around emerging therapeutic modalities—including genetic medicines, innovative biotherapeutics, and RNA therapies—through the design and implementation of innovative GenAI\-based and agentic knowledge solutions. Your leadership will enable AbbVie to leverage high\-value insights extracted, harmonized, and integrated from literature, patents, news, and competitor intelligence. In this role, you will collaborate cross\-functionally with other EKA/IR and business teams to develop and deploy AI\-powered and data science solutions that support AbbVie’s pipeline strategy, corporate strategy, and R\&D initiatives. The position requires a strong background in both science and technology, and the ability to rapidly learn and adapt to new scientific advances in therapeutic modalities and information technology (such as generative AI solutions and AI agents), given the dynamic and expanding landscape.
   

  

**Make Your Mark**
* Conceive, design, and implement advanced AI\-powered published insights solutions (incl. agentic workflows) that address significant scientific and strategic trends and knowledge gaps in therapeutic modalities.
* Develop and deliver innovative, high\-quality intelligence solutions that systematically extract, analyze, summarize, integrate and proactively monitor key knowledge about novel therapeutic modalities (such as gene/cell therapies and innovative RNA or antibody\-based drugs) to address urgent scientific and business needs.
* Apply broad expertise in knowledge \& information science, Generative AI/NLP, data warehousing, and software development to build robust data pipelines and analytical workflows for large and complex published (often unstructured) data, including literature publications, patents, news/press releases, and competitor pipelines.
* Demonstrate deep knowledge of pharmaceutical R\&D, drug development, and therapeutic modality trends.
* Operate with high autonomy and productivity, proactively tackling complex problems and driving multiple projects with minimal supervision.
* Pursue and evaluate relevant external and internal leads in novel modalities, new technologies, and data sources—rapidly incorporating new findings into project strategies and generate novel, actionable insights for R\&D and business strategy.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with scientific, corporate strategy, and other R\&D teams to ensure solutions meet real\-world needs, fill knowledge gaps, and democratize access to key intelligence.
* Mentor or supervise junior data \& information scientists.
* Stay at the forefront of emerging trends, methodologies, and technologies that can advance therapeutic modality \& competitor intelligence at Abbvie.
* Author high\-impact presentations and publications, communicating findings to diverse audiences.
* Ensure adherence to AbbVie’s standards of compliance, data security, GxP, and code of conduct.
* Achieve great results, while overwhelmingly demonstrating key AbbVie values and behaviors.


 Qualifikationen
   

  

**This Is How You Make a Difference**
* PhD (with 4\+ years relevant experience) in life sciences (biology, pharmacology, chemistry, biotechnology, bioinformatics, pharmacy, medicine, biomedical data science, or related). Equivalent experience considered at Master's (10\+ years) or Bachelor's (12\+ years) level. Pharmaceutical industry experience strongly preferred.
* Deep knowledge of emerging therapeutic modalities, such as biotherapeutics (ADCs, mAbs, multispecific antibodies, cell therapies, etc.), different types of degraders, gene therapies (AAV, lentiviral, CAR\-T, CRISPR, etc.), RNA therapies (mRNA, siRNA, ASO), as shown in recent industry advances.
* Hands\-on expertise with extraction and integration of knowledge from literature, patents, competitive intelligence databases (e.g., Citeline, Cortellis), and news/press release sources.
* Competence in using GenAI models for knowledge extraction. Solid knowledge of applications and pitfalls in applying current GenAI models, their prompting, and embedding them in larger Python\-based workflows to automate knowledge extraction tasks. Basic understanding of agents and agentic workflows (MCP, A2A).
* Solid background in programming, informatics, and data science. Proficiency in Python required; familiarity with data engineering, software development principles, relational databases and SQL as well as common formats/APIs. Knowledge of data pipeline frameworks, text mining, NLP, semantic enrichment, ontologies is a plus.
* Ability to rapidly learn and adapt to new advances in therapeutic modalities and information technologies, such as generative AI and agents, reflecting the dynamic and expanding landscape.
* Demonstrated leadership in designing and delivering creative technology solutions that advance business and scientific objectives; proven ability to translate complex scientific/business questions into actionable, large\-scale information solutions, also to non\-scientific audiences and different leadership levels.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem\-solving skills, with superior attention to detail and high degree of reliability and integrity. Comfortable working in fast\-paced, dynamic, multidisciplinary, and collaborative settings, and balancing multiple projects with constantly shifting priorities.
* Demonstrates scientific curiosity, technical creativity, and a proactive drive for innovation to break new ground in the field of information analysis and insights generation.
* Excellent written and oral English language skills as well as the openness to travel (10%)


**What We Offer You**

* with an attractive salary
* with an intensive onboarding process with a mentor at your side
* with flexible work models for a healthy work\-life balance
* with a corporate health management that offers comprehensive health and exercise programs
* with company social benefits

 At multiple times, we have been globally recognized as a "Great Place to Work" and we are proud to provide our employees with the flexibility to maintain a healthy work\-life balance. We take our impact on the environment and our communities seriously and therefore focus on giving something back on a regular basis. We are committed to equality, equity, diversity and inclusion (EED\&I) – a commitment that is fundamental to us. This includes appreciating different perspectives, creating an inclusive culture and treating all employees with dignity and respect.
   

  

 At AbbVie, your individual contributions count – help us move mountains together. Be a part of our success, grow with us and accomplish more than you could have imagined. Sounds like the perfect career opportunity for you? We look forward to receiving your application! All you need is a complete CV – we will discuss everything else with you in person.

description:
**Company Description**  

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.


At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world. Join Visa and do work that matters — to you, to your community, and to the world.


Progress starts with you.

 **Job Description** **What it's all about \-**


Visa Consulting \& Analytics (VCA) is Visa’s global team of consultants, data scientists, economists, and subject matter experts that drives tangible, impactful, and measurable financial results for Visa’s clients—including financial institutions, issuers, acquirers, and merchants. Across Europe, VCA is organized into regional clusters spanning the UK \& Ireland, South Europe, Nordics \& Baltics, Central Eastern Europe, and Central Europe.


Within VCA, the AI Labs practice is a recently established, high\-impact service line dedicated to helping Visa’s clients design, develop, and deploy AI\-powered agentic solutions that automate and transform core payments and financial services processes. This team sits at the intersection of deep payments domain expertise and cutting\-edge AI engineering—representing a significant strategic investment for Visa Consulting.


The Role


We are looking for a Manager who combines hands\-on payments industry knowledge with deep functional expertise of AI agentic systems. This is not a pure AI engineering role. It is a hybrid position for someone who understands the business logic, regulatory complexity, and operational reality of payments and financial services—and who can translate that understanding into the design, evaluation, and deployment of agentic AI workflows for enterprise clients.


The ideal candidate thinks fluently across two registers: they can hold a strategic conversation with a bank’s head of payments about commercial card optimization, and then turn around to architect an agentic evaluation pipeline or design a RAG\-based context retrieval system for a KYC automation use case. They are a practitioner, not a theorist—someone who has built and shipped agentic systems and understands the nuances of prompt engineering, agent orchestration, tool selection, memory management, and human\-in\-the\-loop design in real enterprise environments.

**What you will do**


Client Engagement \& Delivery

* Lead the end\-to\-end management and execution of AI agentic workflow engagements for Visa’s financial institution and merchant clients across Southern Europe, from initial discovery through deployment and post\-launch optimization.
* Conduct structured assessments to identify client processes best suited for “agentization,” evaluating criteria such as heterogeneous document formats, multi\-system integration needs, clear success metrics, and existing digital infrastructure.
* Design hybrid AI\-human operating models that route routine tasks to agentic systems while preserving human oversight for complex, high\-value, or regulatory\-sensitive decisions.
* Translate complex payments domain requirements—PSD2/3 compliance, commercial card processing rules, cross\-border settlement logic, authorization and authentication flows —into precise agent specifications, evaluation criteria, and system prompts.
* Manage internal and external resources to deliver projects on time and to VCA’s quality standards, including coordination with Visa’s technology and product teams.


AI Agentic System Design \& Oversight

* Design agentic workflow architectures that incorporate prompt engineering, RAG/context construction, tool selection and orchestration, agent memory management, and guardrails for production\-grade financial services environments.
* Develop and maintain rigorous evaluation frameworks—including confidence\-aware assessment methods, AI\-as\-a\-judge protocols, and human\-in\-the\-loop quality gates—to ensure agent reliability, factuality, and compliance.
* Define and enforce systematic experimentation practices: prompt versioning, A/B evaluation, failure mode analysis, and continuous feedback loops that leverage production data to improve agent performance.
* Advise clients on technology stack decisions—comparing low\-code platforms (e.g., Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Automate) against custom agentic development (LangGraph, LangChain, AI Labs APIs)—creating decision frameworks tailored to each client’s complexity, compliance, and scalability requirements.
* Stay current with the rapidly evolving agentic commerce protocol landscape, including Visa’s TAP and Intelligent Commerce platforms, OpenAI/Stripe ACP, Google AP2 and emerging standards—and translate developments into actionable client guidance.


Strategy, Business Development \& Thought Leadership

* Co\-lead go\-to\-market activities for the AI Agentic Workflows \& Agentic Commerce service lines, including client workshops, capability demonstrations, sales presentations, and content development.
* Develop compelling client proposals that combine market intelligence (ROI projections, cost\-benefit analyses, competitive benchmarking) with technically credible implementation plans.
* Build and deepen relationships with senior client stakeholders—from CIOs and CDOs to Heads of Operations—positioning VCA as their trusted advisor on agentic transformation.
* Contribute to the service line’s intellectual capital: frameworks, playbooks, reusable prompt libraries, evaluation benchmarks, and case studies that codify best practices.
* Support the professional development of junior consultants, mentoring them on both payments domain expertise and AI agentic design principles

**Why this role**


You will be joining a founding team building a rapidly\-growing service line from the ground up within one of the world’s most influential payments networks. You will shape the methodology, define the market positioning, and deliver the engagements that establish Visa’s credibility in agentic AI for financial services.

* Be part of a high\-visibility strategic initiative backed by Visa’s senior leadership, operating at the frontier of AI and payments.
* Work directly with C\-level executives at Europe’s leading financial institutions on transformative agentic AI engagements.
* Access Visa’s unmatched payments data, global subject matter experts, and proprietary technology platforms.
* Help define the playbook for an entirely new consulting discipline—AI agentic workflows for financial services—with direct impact on Visa’s strategic roadmap.
* Shape and mentor a growing team of consultants at the intersection of payments and AI.
* Competitive compensation, Visa’s benefits package, relocation allowance, private health and dental care, and continuous learning opportunities.


This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in the office will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

 **Qualifications** **What we'd like from you \-**

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* Hands\-on experience designing, building, or deploying AI\-powered agentic workflows in an enterprise context ideally in financial services, but comparable regulated industries are also valued.
* Professional experience in payments, banking, or financial service with at least 3 years in a consulting, advisory, or strategy role.
* Master’s degree, or equivalent in Business, Economics, Finance, Computer Science, or a related field.
* Strong functional and semi\-technical knowledge of the AI agentic stack, including:
* Prompt engineering: systematic prompt design, versioning, optimization, and evaluation for complex multi\-step agent tasks.
* RAG \& context construction: retrieval pipeline design, chunking strategies, embedding models, hybrid search (term\-based \+ vector), and reranking.
* Agent orchestration: multi\-agent architectures, tool selection and integration, ReAct/Reflexion patterns, and error correction loops.
* Memory \& state management: short\-term vs. long\-term memory design, context window optimization, and conversation management.
* Evaluation \& guardrails: evaluation\-driven development (EDD), AI\-as\-a\-judge frameworks, confidence scoring, hallucination detection, and human\-in\-the\-loop quality gates.
* AI interfaces: experience designing user\-facing AI applications (chatbots, copilots, browser extensions, agent\-based tools).
* Familiarity with agentic frameworks and tooling such as LangGraph, LangChain, OpenAI Agents SDK, Claude Agent SDK, Microsoft Copilot Studio, or equivalent.
* Understanding of inference optimization concepts (latency, throughput, cost management) and when to apply fine\-tuning vs. prompt engineering vs. RAG.
* Payments \& Financial Services Expertise
* Deep understanding of payments value chains: issuing, acquiring, processing, settlement, and the regulatory frameworks that govern them (PSD2, PSD3, MiCA, AML/KYC directives).
* Experience working with card networks, issuers, acquirers, or payment processors. Familiarity with commercial cards, cross\-border payments, or other payment systems is a strong plus.
* Demonstrated ability to engage C\-level executives at major financial institutions, translate business challenges into structured project scopes, and deliver high\-impact consulting engagements.
* Professional \& Leadership Skills
* Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent projects, balancing strategic advisory with hands\-on technical oversight.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication in English. Spanish proficiency is highly valued. Additional European languages are a plus.
* Executive\-level presentation and storytelling skills—comfortable presenting to C\-suite audiences at Fortune 500 financial institutions.
* Experience mentoring and developing junior team members in both business consulting and technical AI capabilities.

  

**Additional Information**  

Visa is an EEO Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: AI Relationship Models Leader for CIB
description:
**Excited to grow your career?**  



BBVA is a global company with more than 160 years of history that operates in more than 25 countries where we serve more than 80 million customers. We are more than 121,000 professionals working in multidisciplinary teams with profiles as diverse as financiers, legal experts, data scientists, developers, engineers and designers.


**Learn more about the area:**  



**Corporate \& Investment Banking – The 8**

La Banca Corporativa y de Inversión (CIB) de BBVA es la unidad que acompaña a grandes corporaciones, instituciones financieras e inversores en sus decisiones estratégicas, ofreciendo soluciones financieras globales y especializadas.


Integra capacidades de banca corporativa, banca de inversión y mercados globales, proporcionando financiación estructurada, asesoramiento en M\&A y mercados de capitales, así como soluciones de cobertura y gestión de riesgos.


CIB es un pilar estratégico del Grupo, con fuerte orientación internacional, alta especialización y foco en la excelencia, la sostenibilidad y la gestión prudente del riesgo.


**About the job:**

Este rol se enmarca directamente dentro de la prioridad estratégica “The 8” , el plan de transformación en IA del Grupo orientado a redefinir la propuesta de valor al cliente y a impulsar una automatización extrema de los modelos operativos.


Buscamos un/a Responsable de Negocio para proyectos relacionados con IA que lidere la definición funcional y de negocio de soluciones digitales y de Inteligencia Artificial para CIB. La responsabilidad principal del rol se centra en la definición funcional, la coordinación transversal y la orquestación de iniciativas de IA desde una perspectiva de negocio, actuando como nexo entre las áreas implicadas, más que en la gestión técnica o la ejecución directa de los proyectos.


El rol contribuirá de forma activa al desarrollo de iniciativas clave vinculadas a los robots en la transformación de la experiencia del banquero y del cliente, especialmente en la evolución hacia un AI Banker y capacidades avanzadas de agentificación del escritorio comercial.


Su misión será definir cómo debe cambiar el modelo de relación y la forma de trabajo de la fuerza de ventas con la incorporación de herramientas basadas en IA que maximicen su eficiencia, capacidad de anticipación y calidad de asesoramiento, asegurando al mismo tiempo la alineación con los procesos de riesgos, cumplimiento y gobierno del dato.


La posición tiene una visión transversal y estratégica , con ownership sobre la definición de iniciativas, la priorización del roadmap funcional y la medición del impacto de negocio, identificando sinergias con otros procesos críticos del ciclo de vida del cliente. Trabajando en estrecha colaboración con equipos de Data, Engineering, Riesgos y Compliance.


**Responsabilidades principales:**

* Liderazgo de negocio y funcional:



	+ Definir la visión funcional y de producto de soluciones de IA que transformen la manera de trabajar de los banqueros y su orientación hacia el cliente.
	+ Identificar y priorizar oportunidades de integración de los flujos de admisión de riesgos y onboarding dentro de la experiencia del banquero, impulsando una visión 360º del cliente y una toma de decisiones más ágil y de mayor calidad.
	+ Ejercer el gobierno del valor de las soluciones , asegurando su alineación con los objetivos estratégicos del negocio, la creación de impacto medible y la satisfacción de clientes y banqueros, mediante la definición y seguimiento de KPIs de negocio.
	+ Establecer los criterios de priorización y tomar decisiones sobre el roadmap funcional, consolidando y ordenando las demandas de las distintas áreas de negocio en coordinación con el Program Owner.
	+ Asegurar que las soluciones habiliten un ahorro real de tiempo y una mayor capacidad de anticipación comercial , incorporando principios de “esfuerzo mínimo” y proactividad basada en IA.
	+ Liderar , junto con los equipos correspondientes, la adopción y el gobierno del cambio en las geografías , garantizando una implantación consistente y la incorporación sistemática del feedback al modelo.

* Definir los criterios funcionales de calidad, rendimiento y aceptación necesarios para evaluar soluciones basadas en IA Generativa. Esto incluye:



	+ Definir los criterios funcionales de calidad, aceptación y rendimiento de soluciones basadas en IA Generativa.
	+ Establecer qué se considera una respuesta correcta, útil y aceptable desde el punto de vista de negocio. Indicar el nivel de tolerancia al error y el comportamiento esperado cuando la solución no tenga una respuesta clara.
	+ Ejercer el gobierno de los criterios de calidad y valor de las respuestas generadas por las soluciones de IA, definiendo los umbrales de tolerancia al error y el comportamiento ante la incertidumbre, en colaboración con Data y Engineering, pero con responsabilidad última sobre el qué es correcto y valioso desde la perspectiva de negocio.
	+ Proporcionar casos de uso reales y escenarios representativos del día a día.
	+ Definir niveles de tolerancia al error , comportamiento esperado ante incertidumbre y clasificación de errores según impacto.
	+ Establecer requisitos de formato, tono, idioma y consistencia de las respuestas generadas.
	+ Definir los criterios mínimos de aceptación para el despliegue de soluciones.

* Dirección Estratégica de Negocio de Iniciativas de IA y Robótica



	+ Definir la hoja de ruta de los proyectos desde la perspectiva de la prioridad para el negocio y su impacto.
	+ La responsabilidad del rol se centra en definir prioridades estratégicas, criterios de éxito y KPIs de negocio , dejando la ejecución técnica y operativa en los equipos correspondientes.
	+ Garantizar que las soluciones desplegadas generen impacto tangible y medible en eficiencia operativa, optimización del esfuerzo y creación de valor, impulsando modelos de anticipación proactiva de oportunidades comerciales y toma de decisiones basada en IA a escala.

* Gestión global y coordinación con las distintas geografías de CIB



	+ Coordinar con equipos de negocio , garantizando la adopción y el uso del entregable, siguiendo el modelo de despliegue global de proyectos en el área.
	+ Promover y asegurar definiciones funcionales globales acordes a las necesidades de todas las geografías, que habiliten el mayor nivel de globalidad posible en los desarrollos que se aborden.

* KPIs y visión de datos



	+ Definir KPIs de éxito centrados en:
	
	
	
		- Adopción de herramientas de IA por parte de los banqueros.
		- Eficiencia (reducción de carga operativa y tiempos de preparación).
		- Impacto en negocio (captura de oportunidades estratégicas, cross\-selling y calidad del asesoramiento).
		- Hacer seguimiento del impacto y proponer ajustes para maximizar el valor generado.

**Sobre ti:**

Buscamos una persona con visión integral del negocio bancario de CIB, capaz de conectar las necesidades comerciales con las exigencias de riesgos y cumplimiento.


Debes tener habilidades para liderar en entornos matriciales y traducir procesos complejos en soluciones digitales ágiles.


Es fundamental la capacidad para trabajar con responsables de Data y Tecnología para implementar soluciones de GenAI que posicionen al banco como pionero


**Requisitos profesionales:**

* Formación superior en Ingeniería, ADE, Economía u otras formaciones STEM/Business relacionados.
* Experiencia sólida y contrastada en el asesoramiento estratégico de alto valor a clientes de BEI o CIB.
* Conocimiento operativo real del modelo de relación de CIB . Se requiere experiencia demostrable del modelo, con conocimiento de sus puntos de fricción (Onboarding, Riesgos, Preparación comercial y Coordinación con especialistas).
* Ejercer como referente en conocimiento de negocio , garantizando su correcta traducción en capacidades de IA y robótica, y asegurando que las decisiones estratégicas, y de priorización maximicen el impacto en eficiencia, experiencia de cliente y generación de valor.
* Conocimiento profundo y demostrable de los productos de BEI y CIB y su modelo de articulación conjunta.
* Conocimiento sectorial profundo, con experiencia real en sectores relevantes, y capacidad para escalar ese conocimiento a modelos globales y a soluciones de negocio apoyadas en datos e Inteligencia Artificial, en coordinación con equipos de CIB cuando aplique.
* Experiencia en interlocución con diferentes stakeholders de alto nivel, experiencia en toma de decisiones y alineamiento de diferentes prioridades.
* Experiencia sólida y demostrable en entornos internacionales complejos así como en la toma de decisiones y priorizaciones divergentes.
* Experiencia sólida y contrastada en la aplicación real de la Inteligencia Artificial al negocio, con criterio para evaluar su impacto en los modelos de relación, identificar oportunidades de alto valor y reconocer sus límites, riesgos y estándares de calidad, integrándose de forma responsable y exigente en la toma de decisiones y en el asesoramiento estratégico a clientes
* Inglés: nivel alto (mínimo C1\) , para la coordinación global.

**Qué ofrecemos:**

Participar de forma directa en una de las prioridades estratégicas más relevantes del Grupo: The 8, contribuyendo a redefinir el futuro del modelo de relación con clientes de empresas mediante IA.


Oportunidad de trabajar en u n entorno global, colaborativo y data\-driven, con visibilidad directa sobre la estrategia comercial en múltiples países.


Oportunidad de influir de forma directa en la evolución del rol del banquero y en el uso responsable de la IA en banca.


**Skills:**

Customer Targeting, Empathy, Ethics, Innovation, Proactive Thinking

Manager BI

Todo ello ayudando a las principales organizaciones del mundo a descubrir el valor de la tecnología y a construir un mundo más sostenible e inclusivo.  

¿Te apetece sumarte a nosotros y participar en proyectos multisectoriales en un equipo conformado por profesionales del dato como Data Scientists, Data Engineers o Data Analysts? Nuestro objetivo es ayudar a nuestros clientes en el camino hacia la innovación continua.  

Buscamos un/a Tech Leader BI para liderar la arquitectura, el desarrollo y la entrega de nuestras soluciones de Business Intelligence. Será una figura clave en el solutioning, el delivery y el liderazgo tanto técnico como de equipos en proyectos estratégicos.


Descripción larga
¿Qué harás en el proyecto? ¿Cuál será tu rol?

* Liderar el diseño y la arquitectura de las soluciones BI de principio a fin.
* Participar activamente en el solutioning: análisis, propuesta técnica y definición de roadmap.
* Participar en el delivery de los proyectos, asegurando la correcta ejecución, calidad y cumplimiento de plazos.
* Coordinar, acompañar y supervisar al equipo técnico BI (interno y externo).
* Definir estándares, buenas prácticas y guías técnicas.
* Garantizar la escalabilidad, fiabilidad y rendimiento de las soluciones.
* Colaborar estrechamente con Data Engineers, analistas, Product Owners y stakeholders de negocio.
* Impulsar la adopción de tecnologías innovadoras y enfoques modernos en el área de datos.


Para desenvolverte bien en la posición se requieren conocimientos en/de:  

* \+5 años de experiencia en entorno BI y analítica de datos.
* Experiencia liderando equipos técnicos y proyectos end\-to\-end.
* Dominio de herramientas BI (Power BI, Tableau, Qlik, Looker…).
* Conocimientos sólidos en modelado de datos, arquitecturas cloud (Azure, AWS o GCP) y Data Warehousing.
* Habilidad para traducir necesidades de negocio en soluciones técnicas.
* Alta capacidad de comunicación, liderazgo y gestión.
  

Valoramos también :

* Experiencia en arquitecturas modernas (Lakehouse, Databricks, Snowflake…).
* SQL avanzado y orquestación de pipelines.
* Certificaciones cloud o BI.
* Mentalidad proactiva, orientada al delivery y la mejora continua.

Descripción larga
Se valorará positivamente el poseer certificado de discapacidad, en el marco de nuestra política de inclusión y diversidad.  

Valoraremos todas las candidaturas. Contamos con una amplísima oferta formativa, presencial, online de Certificaciones, etc. Aunque no tengas el 100% de los conocimientos valorados ¡nos encantará conocerte!

¿Qué te gustará de trabajar aquí?

SAVANA (www.savanamed.com) is an award\-winning, international medical company aiming to accelerate health science by putting into the hands of healthcare providers the power to unlock all of the clinical value embedded within existing Electronic Health Records (EHRs) with Artificial Intelligence and Natural Language Processing. With the largest AI\-enabled, multi\-language, multi\-center research network in the world, Savana generates customized descriptive and predictive, High\-quality Deep Real World Evidence research studies.  Savana operantes in more than 160 hospitals, 5 languages, 15 countries and has already improved more than 6 clinical practices with more than 100 employees from 10 nationalities. It constitutes a clinical research ecosystem that aims to advance personalized and precision medicine worldwide.

They interact primarily with the Medical Unit team, with whom they must establish effective communication. Nonetheless, their role is also transversal within the organisation, enabling them to contribute their scientific knowledge to any area.

* Development of Savana Research Study Protocols: drafting the analysis strategy for each study objective, calculation of minimum sample size.

* Development of new analytic strategies/pipelines to improve and maintain the Clinical Data Science analysis workflow.
* Data cleansing, wrangling/munging from raw data to analysis\-ready data formats.
* Support in the development of NLP models and in the analysis of NLP model output.
* Providing scientific support across the organisation.
* Performance of statistical analysis, application of different statistical methods ranging from descriptive to inferential. Graphical presentation of results.
* Development of multivariable explicative and predictive models. Development and maintenance of machine\-learning frameworks for model training and validation.
* Knowledge of explainability and uncertainty calculation of predictive models.
* Presentation of analysis results to different audiences (internal staff, reports to clients, etc).

* Ensure familiarity with and adherence to the organization's information security policies and procedures.

* Adhere to Savana’s Quality Management System (QMS) policies, procedures, and applicable laws and regulations.
* Participate in and complete assigned training activities.

***Skills, Experience and Qualifications required:***




  




* University degree in a strong quantitative field (mathematics, engineering, statistics, computer science) or university degree in biomedical field (medicine, biology, pharmacy) with a master’s degree or PhD with strong quantitative component (statistics, bioinformatics, epidemiology, etc).
* Strong academic background with experience in grant proposals and scientific paper publications, preferably in the field of clinical prediction / survival analysis. Previous experience in Machine Learning models applied to clinical scenarios is a plus.
* Postgraduate degree in the field of Data Science/Machine Learning or 1\-2 years of equivalent professional experience is a plus.
* Programming skills in Python and familiarity with Jupyter in collaborative environments.
* Desirably programming skills in one or more of the following languages: python, R, SQL.
* English: professional working proficiency.
* Ability to work in a multinational, multidisciplinary and fast\-growing environment.



  





  





***We offer:***




  




* Work with a multidisciplinary team of clinicians, computer engineers, computational linguists, mathematicians, designers, medical Natural Language Processing expert programmers and other disciplines. title: Data scientist
description:
At Bending Spoons, we’re striving to build one of the all\-time great companies. A company that serves a huge number of customers. A company where team members grow to their full potential. A company that functions at unparalleled levels of effectiveness and efficiency. A company that creates value for shareowners at an extraordinary rate. And a company that does so while adhering to high ethical standards.
   

  

 To achieve this objective, we execute the following strategy: We acquire a digital business with untapped potential and make it as successful as we can by leveraging our platform—which comprises our expertise, technologies, data, brand, talents, and company culture. Then, we invest the proceeds into making our platform more powerful, and into acquiring new businesses. Thus, our strategy sees us combine an investor’s attention to capital allocation with the hands\-on approach of an operator.
   

  

 For a talented, driven, and collaborative individual, working at Bending Spoons is an opportunity to learn, make an impact, and progress their career at an exceptionally high rate. That’s our promise to such a candidate.
   

  

**A few examples of your responsibilities** 
* Collaborate with Product and Business teams to determine the most pressing questions that big data can help answer, and then figure out how to uncover those insights.
* Query and analyze massive sets of usage data to identify product\-improvement opportunities and actionable insights to profoundly impact our product strategy and roadmap.
* Create brief, high\-quality reports to explain your findings and discuss their implications with the relevant team members.
* Screen the app stores and study competing products in search of insights and ideas we could learn from.
* Help direct the development of our technologies devoted to the acquisition, storage, and manipulation of big data, supporting our efforts to constantly break new ground in this field.


**What we look for** 
* **Reasoning ability.** 
 Given the necessary knowledge, you can solve complex problems. You think from first principles, and structure your ideas sharply. You resist the influence of biases. You identify and take care of the details that matter.
* **Drive.** 
 You’re extremely ambitious in everything you do—and your initiative, effort, and tenacity match the intensity of your ambition. You feel deeply responsible for your work. You hold yourself to a high—and rising—bar.
* **Team spirit.** 
 You give generously and without the expectation of receiving in return. You support the best idea, not your idea. You're always happy to get your hands dirty to help your team. You’re reliable, honest, and transparent.
* **Proficiency in English.** 
 You read, write, and speak proficiently in English.


**What we offer** 
* **Incredibly talented, entrepreneurial teams.** 
 You’ll work in small, result\-oriented, autonomous teams alongside some of the brightest people in your field.
* **An exceptional opportunity for growth.** 
 We go to great lengths to hire individuals of outstanding potential—then, our priority is to put them in the ideal position to thrive. Spooners in their 20s lead products worth hundreds of millions of dollars. And if you’ve got what it takes, you’ll soon be playing an essential role in major projects, too.
* **Competitive pay and access to equity in the company.** 
 Typically, we offer individuals at the start of their career an annual salary of £85,797 in London and €66,065 elsewhere in Europe. For a candidate that we assess as possessing considerable relevant experience, the salary on offer tends to be between £112,189 and £250,512 in London, and €107,837 and €188,848 elsewhere in Europe. Compensation varies by location and expected impact, and grows rapidly as you gain experience and translate it into greater contributions. For individuals who demonstrate exceptional capability, we may offer compensation that extends beyond the usual ranges to reflect their higher expected impact. If you're offered a permanent contract, you'll also be able receive some of your pay in company equity at a discounted price, thus participating in the value creation we achieve together. If relocating to Italy, you may enjoy a 50% tax cut.
* **All. These. Benefits.** 
 Flexible hours, remote working, unlimited backing for learning and training, top\-of\-the\-market health insurance, a rich relocation package, generous parental support, and a yearly retreat to a stunning location. We help each Spooner set up the conditions to do their best work.


**Commitment \& contract**
 Permanent or fixed\-term. Full\-time or part\-time.
   

  

**Location**
 Milan (Italy), London (UK), Madrid (Spain), Warsaw (Poland) or remote in selected countries.
   

  

**The selection process**
 In our screening process, we prioritize verifiable signals of excellence, regardless of seniority. Some people hold back because they feel they lack experience or have an “imperfect” CV. If you like the role and believe you could excel over time, don’t self\-reject.
   

  

 If you pass our screening, you’ll be asked to complete one or more tests. They are challenging, may involve unfamiliar problems, and can take several hours.
   

  

 We set the bar high and won’t extend an offer until we’re confident we’ve found the right candidate. This is why a job may remain open for months or be reposted several times.
   

  

 We consider all applicants for employment and provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities—please let us know through this form.
   

  

**Before you apply**
 If you’ve applied before but didn't receive an offer, we recommend waiting at least one year before applying again.
   

  

 Bending Spoons is a demanding environment. We’re extremely ambitious and we hold ourselves—and one another—to a high standard. While this tends to lead to extraordinary learning, achievement, and career growth, it also requires significant commitment.
   

  

 To help you ramp up quickly and set yourself up for success, we recommend spending your first few months working from our Milan office, regardless of your long\-term work location. It’s the best way to rapidly absorb our company culture and build trust with your new teammates. We’ll support you with generous travel and accommodation assistance. After that, you’re welcome to work from our offices in Milan or London, or remotely from approved countries—depending on what we agree at the offer stage.
   

  

 If the role speaks to you and you’re excited to give your best, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now—we can’t wait to meet you.

title: Data Scientist
description:
**🚀 Job Opportunity: Data Scientist** 





 Performance Intelligence Startup · Remote\-first · England or Spain
 




**💰 £45,000 – £70,000 depending on experience** 




  





 🏢 About the Company
 


 This is a really exciting opportunity with a fast\-growing performance intelligence startup with a genuinely clever concept — think elite sports coaching, but applied to the workplace. The company helps employees, teams, and organisations reach peak performance by uncovering the root causes that hold people back, delivering personalised, data\-driven insights and actionable solutions.
 




  






 They drive measurable business impact across things like sales growth, AI adoption, employee retention, burnout reduction, and risk management. It is, in short, a platform that takes data seriously and actually does something useful with it. Refreshing, right?
 




  






 The company is building toward an agent\-first platform where AI becomes the primary interface for users — and they are looking for a talented Data Scientist to help make that a reality.
 




  





 🤖 The Role
 


 (No, you won't just be cleaning CSV files for eternity — though fair warning, some of that is inevitable in any data job.)
 




  






 This is a hands\-on, high\-impact position where the successful candidate will:
 




  





 ▸   
 
 Build, train, and deploy machine learning models — from exploratory analysis through to production\-ready solutions that power the platform. Real models, in the real world. Not just PowerPoints about models.
 




 ▸   
 
 Develop and deploy AI agents using Databricks, Google AI Studio and/or Azure AI Foundry. These agents are the primary user interface for the product — so this is genuinely central to what the company does.
 




 ▸   
 
 Apply statistical rigour to psychometric and survey data, validating the company's proprietary measurement framework and identifying correlations that drive actionable insights.
 




 ▸   
 
 Advance analytical capabilities beyond aggregation — into predictive modelling, deep learning, and generative AI applications. The ambition is there; they just need the right person to execute it.
 




 ▸   
 
 Work closely with the CTO and tech team to integrate models into the platform. Collaboration is key — this is not a lone\-wolf role.
 




 ▸   
 
 Translate complex findings into clear, actionable insights for product decisions and client\-facing reports. The ability to explain results to non\-technical stakeholders is genuinely valued here.
 




  





 ✅ What They're Looking For
 


 The must\-haves (non\-negotiable, unfortunately — they checked):
 




  





 ▸   H
 
 ands\-on experience in data science, machine learning, or applied statistics.
 




 ▸   
 
 Strong Python skills with experience in ML frameworks such as scikit\-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, or similar.
 




 ▸   
 
 Solid grounding in statistics — hypothesis testing, regression, correlation analysis, and experimental design.
 




 ▸   
 
 Experience with SQL and data manipulation at scale.
 




 ▸   
 
 Comfortable with ambiguity and working independently in a fast\-moving startup environment. This is not a company with 47 layers of sign\-off. Decisions happen quickly.
 




 ▸   
 
 Professional English proficiency (B2\+ level).
 




  





 ⭐ Nice to Have
 


 Bonus points — none of these are dealbreakers, but they would make a hiring manager very happy:
 




  





 ▸   
 
 Experience with GenAI, LLMs, SLMs, prompt engineering, or agentic AI workflows. Given the direction of the product, this is increasingly relevant.
 




 ▸   
 
 Cloud AI platform experience — GCP, Azure, Databricks, or similar.
 




 ▸   
 
 Startup experience. You know what wearing multiple hats feels like, and you didn't hate it.
 




 ▸   
 
 A background in behavioural science, organisational psychology, or psychometrics — the company works heavily with survey data and measurement validation.
 




 ▸   
 
 Spark, Databricks, or distributed computing experience.
 




 ▸   
 
 Published research or an academic background in statistics, ML, or a quantitative field.
 




  





 🎁 What's on Offer
 

 ▸   
 
 💰 Salary of £45,000–£70,000 depending on experience, with bi\-annual salary reviews.
 




 ▸   
 
 🏠 Remote\-first, flexible working environment. The company trusts its people to get the job done.
 




 ▸   
 
 🚀 A genuine opportunity to join a high\-potential startup at an exciting stage and directly influence the product, technical direction, and culture.
 




 ▸   
 
 🧠 High ownership, ideas actually get built here, rather than disappearing into a backlog black hole.
 




 ▸   
 
 📈 A high\-growth career trajectory as the team and product scale.
 




 ▸   
 
 A team culture that values passion, autonomy, continuous learning, and collaborative problem\-solving. Small egos encouraged.
 




  





 📍 Location
 


 Valencia, Spain or East Midlands, England is preferred but the company is open to candidates across England or Spain. The role requires willingness to meet in person once a month (and more as needed). Worth it for the Valencia weather alone, frankly.

description:
**Product Line Manager – Global Data and AI Platforms**
=======================================================

* *Location: Barcelona*

**About Sanofi**
----------------


We are an innovative global healthcare company, driven by one purpose: we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives. Our team, across some 100 countries, is dedicated to transforming the practice of medicine by working to turn the impossible into the possible. We provide potentially life\-changing treatment options and life\-saving vaccine protection to millions of people globally, while putting sustainability and social responsibility at the center of our ambitions.


Sanofi has recently embarked into a vast and ambitious digital transformation program. A cornerstone of this roadmap is the acceleration of its data transformation and of the adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) solutions, to accelerate R\&D, manufacturing and commercial performance and bring better drugs and vaccines to patients faster, to improve health and save lives.

**Who You Are**
---------------


We are looking for a Product Line Manager – Global Data \& AI Platforms to join our Digital Data \& AI organization. This is a high\-impact leadership role for someone who thrives at the intersection of product, platform technology, and enterprise\-scale delivery. You will own the vision, strategy, accountability and execution for enterprise\-scale Data and AI platform products that enable thousands of technical users across Sanofi to build, deploy, and scale AI and Data solutions with speed and confidence.


As Product Line Manager, you own the entire lifecycle of your product line — from ideation through exploration, validation, growth, sustainability, and eventual retirement. You are the key decision maker: you conceive, define, deliver, and evolve platform products to maximize business value. You are accountable not just for shipping features, but for delivering measurable outcomes through scalable, self\-service platforms that make data and AI accessible to everyone who needs them.


This role requires you to operate fluidly across technology, data engineering, data science, and governance domains. You will build strategic partnerships, lead and mentor a team of Product Owners, Analysts and Scrum Coaches, and collaborate daily with platform and AIOps engineers, and data scientists in agile pod structures.

**Our vision for digital, data analytics and AI**


Join us on our journey in enabling Sanofi’s Digital Transformation through becoming an AI first organization. This means:

* **AI Factory \- Versatile Teams Operating in Cross Functional Pods:** Utilizing digital and data resources to develop AI products, bringing data management, AI and product development skills to products, programs, and projects to create an agile, fulfilling, and meaningful work environment
* **Leading Edge Tech Stack:** Experience building products that will be deployed globally on a leading\-edge tech stack
* **World Class Mentorship and Training:** Working with renown leaders and academics in machine learning to further develop your skillsets

**Job Highlights**
------------------

### **Product Line Strategy and Vision**

* Define and communicate a compelling product line vision and roadmap aligned with Enterprise Data \& AI Platform goals and Sanofi's enterprise digital strategy
* Establish the product ecosystem and build strategic partnerships across Sanofi Digital and Business groups to drive adoption, alignment, and exceptional user experience
* Identify common patterns across AI/ML use cases to build reusable, scalable platform capabilities that accelerate time\-to\-value
* Define KPIs, success metrics, and value propositions; make data\-driven decisions using a clear framework
* Ensure platforms meet all quality, regulatory (Data Privacy, GxP, SOX), and cybersecurity requirements
* Rigorously evaluate Data and AI technology innovation in the market, and establish opportunities to introduce leading\-edge platform components to Sanofi users
* Maintain operational excellence and resilience at global scale

### **Execution and Delivery**

* Manage the product backlog across the product line, ensuring clear priorities, continuous refinement, and well\-defined requirements and user stories
* Define release strategy, deciding when sufficient value has been accrued to warrant a release to customers
* Partner with the central Digital Data organization to align on architecture, priorities, technical capability needs, and roadmaps
* Drive launch readiness and lead post\-launch adoption across cross\-functional teams
* Understand and adjust for the nuances of cloud, data, and AI infrastructure, vendor capabilities, and technical user needs
* Continuously assess and improve product management processes to maximize team efficiency, velocity, and impact
* Own the product line budget and resource allocation, ensuring efficient use of resources while achieving strategic goals

### **User Advocacy and Value**

* Act as the internal voice of technical users — representing data engineers, ML engineers, analysts, data scientists, and other platform consumers
* Lead change management initiatives including training programs, user onboarding, and support mechanisms to drive successful adoption
* Incorporate user feedback to deliver continuous improvements and measurable business value
* Track outcomes and continuously improve product value through defined success metrics and KPIs

### **Team Leadership and Collaboration**

* Build, lead, and mentor a team of Product Managers and cross\-functional product team members to deliver on the product line vision and strategy
* Challenge, prioritize, and negotiate with business and digital partners to drive alignment toward the product vision
* Lead and influence teams without direct authority across organizational boundaries — rallying engineers, data scientists, and stakeholders around shared goals
* Collaborate daily with engineers, data scientists, ML engineers, and scrum masters in agile pod structures, providing guidance and resolving ambiguities
* Provide clear, consistent updates to senior leadership on product progress, challenges, and decisions

**Key Functional Requirements \& Qualifications**
-------------------------------------------------

* 10\+ years in digital product management, preferably within Digital Data and AI platforms or related technical platform domains
* A track record of building scalable data/AI platforms aligned to business outcomes, with self\-service capabilities that empower technical users
* Proven experience leading product teams and driving agile product\-development practices at enterprise scale
* Strong business acumen with the ability to seamlessly connect business priorities with technical solutions
* Skilled at prioritizing competing demands in complex, multinational environments
* Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to influence senior leaders and diverse stakeholders
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross\-functional teams without direct authority — clarifying requirements, resolving conflicts, defining roadmaps, and ensuring execution
* Creative problem\-solver who challenges existing processes and proposes innovative approaches
* Naturally curious — asking "why" to uncover underlying needs and "how" to shape effective solutions

**Key Technical Requirements \& Qualifications**
------------------------------------------------

* Deep understanding of data and AI platform products built for technical users, and the ability to collaborate effectively with engineers, ML engineers, and data scientists
* Strong knowledge of platform technologies (cloud, data, AI/ML) and how they enable business value at scale
* Experience with modern cloud ecosystems (AWS, Azure) and contemporary data platforms (Snowflake, data lakes, data warehouses, cloud\-native solutions)
* Understanding of DataOps, MLOps, ML engineering, and AI/ML pipelines
* Exposure to data mesh architectures, API development, and cloud\-native design patterns
* Background in Data Engineering, AIOps / MLOps, Data Science, Data Architecture preferred

**Why Join Us?**
----------------


At Sanofi, you will:

* Build AI\-powered, data/AI\-centric products deployed at global scale

title: Senior Data Scientist - Applied Machine Learning
description:
**Let’s fix hospitality, for good.**


Hospitality is tough – margins are thin, waste is high, and teams are stretched. But it doesn’t have to be this hard. That’s why we built **Nory**.


Our CEO, Conor, knows the pain first\-hand. After founding and scaling Mad Egg in Ireland, he got fed up with juggling “market\-leading” systems, clunky spreadsheets, and endless printouts. So he set out to build the tool he wished he’d had from day one.


Nory is an all\-knowing restaurant management system. It blends real\-time data with AI predictive analytics, giving operators control of their margins. From food prep to forecasting, it’s operational intelligence that helps restaurants run with consistency, certainty, and profit. The result? Thriving restaurants, better jobs, less waste, healthier margins. **Learn more about what we are building** **here****.**


And we’re just getting started. Fresh off a Series B led by Kinnevik, we’ve grown to 80\+ people across Ireland, the UK, Spain and New York – and demand is scaling faster than we ever imagined.

### **The role**


We’re looking for a **Senior Data Scientist – Applied Machine Learning** to design, build, and scale machine learning systems that directly power operational decisions across thousands of restaurant shifts every week. This is not a research\-only role. And it’s not about models that live in notebooks.


It’s about building production\-grade ML systems that improve margins – and making sure they keep delivering value long after deployment. **Read more about what it’s like being a Data Scientist at Nory** **here****.**

### **What you’ll be doing**


As a Senior Data Scientist – Applied Machine Learning at Nory, you’ll build and scale production\-grade ML systems that power margin\-critical decisions across **forecasting, labour planning, and operational optimisation** – turning live real\-world restaurant data into measurable profit improvement.

* **Own ML systems end\-to\-end**, from problem framing and data design through to deployment, monitoring, and iteration in production.
* **Build reliable, production\-grade ML services**, working close to APIs, pipelines, and cloud infrastructure to ensure models are robust, observable, and maintainable.
* **Improve operational performance through measurable impact**, increasing forecast accuracy, automation rates, and margin contribution – not just model metrics.
* **Design monitoring and drift strategies from day one**, ensuring models stay accurate, stable, and commercially valuable over time.
* **Apply rigorous statistical thinking**, choosing the right level of complexity and running sound experiments to support clear go / no\-go decisions.
* **Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Commercial teams**, embedding ML into live workflows that operators trust and rely on daily.
* **Raise the bar for applied ML at Nory**, influencing standards, reviewing work, mentoring others, and strengthening our systems thinking as we scale.

### **What you’ll bring:**

* **Proven ownership of production ML systems**, having taken models from an ambiguous problem to a deployed, monitored, revenue\-impacting capability.
* **Strong statistical foundations**, with an MSc, PhD, or equivalent depth in applied statistics, experimentation, and quantitative reasoning.
* **Clean, maintainable SQL and Python skills**, writing code suitable for shared codebases rather than notebooks alone.
* **Production\-first mindset**, comfortable working close to APIs, CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, and modern data tooling.
* **Depth in classical machine learning**, including forecasting, regression, classification, feature engineering, and drift detection – with the judgment to choose the right level of complexity.
* **Experience measuring real business impact**, thinking in terms of automation rates, cost reduction, accuracy uplift, and margin improvement.
* **Systems thinking**, understanding how models interact with data pipelines, product workflows, and operational edge cases.
* **Clear communication skills**, able to explain trade\-offs and influence engineers, PMs, and senior stakeholders.
* **Startup ownership mentality**, proactive, pragmatic, and comfortable operating with autonomy in a fast\-scaling environment.

**Nice\-to\-have:**

* Experience in B2B SaaS or operational domains such as logistics, workforce planning, supply chain, or forecasting\-heavy environments.
* Experience in lean, high\-ownership data teams.


If you’re excited by what we’re building, we’d love to hear from you, even if you don’t tick every box.

### **What you’ll get in return:**


Remote\-first working environment \- please note you must have the right to work in the UK/EU without sponsorship to be considered for this role


Competitive salary range depending on experience


Meaningful equity, at Nory everyone is an owner!


35 days of paid leave per year (including bank holidays)


Comprehensive private health insurance via Irish Life (Ireland) and Axa (UK)


Enhanced parental leave and baby loss support


Learning \& development culture – €1000 personal annual budget \+ quarterly book budget


€250 home office workspace budget


Regular team offsites \& socials


Work from anywhere for up to 3 months of the year


Offices in either **London** , **Dublin** or **Spain**

And much more

### **How we work**

**Our vision is to build a better future for the restaurant industry.**


One where operators are in control, margins are stronger, and frontline teams can build careers they’re proud of. To get there, we move fast, stay focused, and hold ourselves to a high bar. Our values guide how we work, grow, and win – together.


These are the values we live by:

* **We serve up impact with a side of profit:** We prioritise work that delivers real financial results for our restaurant partners.
* **We prioritise speed of service:** We move fast, unblock quickly, and deliver with urgency.
* **We act like owners:** We own problems, raise the bar, and build better every day.
* **We win as a crew:** We grow stronger through feedback, collaboration, and shared wins.

### **We hire humans.**


At Nory, we believe that diverse teams build better products. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, identities, and walks of life. We do not discriminate based on gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, family status, age, disability, or race. What matters to us is how you think, how you work, and what you bring to the table. Please let us know if you require any adjustments so you can bring your best self to the interview process.

dLocal enables the biggest companies in the world to collect payments in 40 countries in emerging markets. As both a payments processor and a merchant of record where we operate, we make it possible for our merchants to make inroads into the world’s fastest\-growing, emerging markets.  

By joining us you will be a part of an amazing global team that makes it all happen. Being a part of dLocal means working with 1000\+ teammates from 30\+ different nationalities and developing an international career that impacts millions of people’s daily lives. We are builders, we never run from a challenge, we are customer\-centric, and if this sounds like you, we know you will thrive in our team. **Role Mission**
We are looking for a high\-impact Data Scientist who thrives on autonomy. In this role, you won’t just execute tasks—you will own the "Why," the "How," and the "So What" of your projects. You will act as a strategic data partner to the business, leveraging cutting\-edge AI tooling to move fast and solving complex problems that directly move the needle for d\-local.  

What type of projects will you work on? We are working on solutions for anomaly detection, forecasting and payments routing. All these require knowledge on unsupervised learning, hybrid time series models, clustering, reinforcement learning, all with a focus on explainability.  


### **What will I be doing?**

* **End\-to\-End Project Ownership:** Drive the execution of complex, high\-impact data projects from ideation to production. You are responsible for ensuring every solution delivers measurable improvements to business performance or customer experience.
* **The "Better Version" Mindset:** Act as a strategic technical consultant. You don’t just follow a brief; you proactively identify business opportunities and challenge stakeholder proposals when a more efficient or impactful data\-driven alternative exists.
* **Impact Quantification:** Before writing code, you identify the core components of a request based on expected outcomes. You use rigorous frameworks to predict experiment results and quantify the business value of your proposed solutions.
* **Technical Deep\-Dives:** Perform root\-cause analysis on a wide range of analytical problems and contribute to incident management. You have the "jump\-in" ability to unblock ongoing projects and identify potential development issues before they scale.
* **Continuous Technical Evolution:** Champion best practices and drive internal initiatives for process improvement. You will contribute to the evolution of our technical knowledge base and raise the collective bar.
* **AI\-Accelerated Development:** Integrate and champion the use of AI\-assisted tooling (LLMs, Copilots, and automated workflows) to boost your development throughput, optimize code quality, and shorten the path from prototype to production.

### **What skills do I need?**

* **Technical Mastery \& Versatility**: 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in applied ML and Statistics. Beyond Python mastery, you can modify algorithm implementations to adapt to specific needs and develop comfortably across diverse environments.
* **AI Tooling \& Productivity**: Proficiency in using AI\-driven development tools to enhance coding performance, automate repetitive tasks, and accelerate data exploration.
* **Advanced Analytics \& Data Strategy**: Strong knowledge of ensemble methods, deep learning. You understand the trade\-offs between technologies (Spark, SQL, AWS SageMaker) and choose the right tool for the specific business challenge.
* **Strategic Stakeholder Influence**: Highly effective at engaging with stakeholders at all levels. You influence decision\-making through advanced data storytelling and a deep understanding of business objectives.
* **Self\-Driven Execution**: Ability to self\-manage and prioritize complex project roadmaps across a business vertical, maintaining sharp attention to detail while handling multiple high\-priority streams.
* **Technical proficiency**: An experienced team player who possesses a curious, positive attitude toward solving highly ambiguous problems.
* **Industry Context**: Experience in payments or financial systems (specifically Anomaly or Fraud detection) is a major plus.
* **Language**: Advanced English is a must.


What do we offer?

**About the role**


We’re looking for a **Senior Data Platform Engineer** to join our Data Platform team and help us scale seQura’s data ecosystem through **automation, platform capabilities, and self\-service tooling**.


Your mission will be to help evolve our Data Platform as a Product, enabling software engineers, analysts, data scientists, and business teams to leverage data across its lifecycle — from ingestion to discovery — while ensuring security, governance, and reliability are built into the platform by default. The goal is to empower teams across the company to access trusted data and make better, data\-driven decisions.


This role goes beyond building pipelines. You’ll design **the guardrails, abstractions, and platform capabilities** that make it easy for other teams to build and scale their own data products safely and efficiently.


You’ll work in a **cloud\-native environment on AWS**, where Infrastructure as Code, observability, and automation are fundamental engineering principles.

**What challenges you'll be solving**

* Design and evolve the **self\-service Data Platform**, enabling engineering and business teams to build and manage their own data products autonomously
* Identify friction points for internal data consumers and **build platform capabilities that improve developer experience**
* Design and maintain a **“Golden Path” for data pipelines**, enabling teams to deploy new pipelines in minutes instead of weeks
* Embed **data governance, observability, lineage, and access control** directly into platform capabilities
* Improve the **reliability, performance, and cost efficiency** of our data infrastructure
* Lead architectural discussions and mentor engineers on **distributed systems and platform design**
* Evangelize the platform internally to drive adoption across teams

**About the Data team**

**Team mission**


To build and evolve a **self\-service data platform** that empowers engineering teams, analysts, and data scientists to build, discover, and scale their own data initiatives with **built\-in governance, observability, and minimal friction**.

**What we own**

* The full lifecycle of data across the company: extraction, ingestion, landing, transformation, governance, and observability
* The data infrastructure and platform capabilities that enable teams to create and scale their own data products
* Core platform components that ensure data quality, compliance, lineage, and discoverability
* The evolution of our data platform into a self\-service ecosystem where teams can autonomously manage their data lifecycle

**Team Structure**


The Data Platform team is a key part of the Data organization, which also includes the Head of Data, Data Governance Lead, Data Science \& AI, and Data Analytics teams.


The Data Platform team currently consists of a Data Platform Lead, four Data Engineers, and one MLOps Engineer. They collaborate closely with the Infrastructure Platform team and the rest of the Data organization to build and evolve the company's data platform.

**How we work**

* Platform mindset: we build **capabilities and tooling**, not one\-off solutions
* Engineers treat internal teams as **platform customers**
* Strong collaboration with **Infrastructure Platform, Data Science \& AI, and Data Analytics teams**
* Infrastructure\-as\-Code and automation are core engineering principles
* We are transitioning from a **reactive ticket\-based model to a product\-oriented platform team**

**What to expect in the next 90 days**

**Month 1:** You’ll immerse yourself in our data stack and our Data Platform philosophy. You’ll meet engineers, analysts, and product teams to understand their current challenges and friction points when working with data. You’ll contribute early improvements to our Infrastructure\-as\-Code, pipelines, or observability stack, with the goal of identifying and fixing a developer experience pain point.

description:
**Job Reference**
-----------------


123\_26\_CSSH\_RE3
**Position**
------------


Lead of Methods and Engineering for SSH (RE3\)
